user_prompt: Determine the maximum force P which may be applied to the truss without exceeding 300.0 kN in tension or 500.0 kN in compression in any member.Identify the maximum allowable force, the critical member(s) that govern this limit (list every member that reaches the limit at that load, in case of a tie), and whether they are in tension or compression.

controlling_member.description: The ID(s) of the member(s) that reach their limit first (e.g., ['AB']). List every member tied for the governing load, not just one, if more than one reaches the limit at the exact same load.

controlling_state.description: The failure mode of the controlling member.
